content_blocks.label: clause_1._Reason_for_Eviction
content_blocks.text: The Tenant is hereby notified that the Tenant has failed to pay the rent in full and on time as required by the lease agreement.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Deadline
content_blocks.text: The Tenant shall vacate the premises located at 789 Pine Street, Greenfield City, within 14 days from the date of this Notice.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Legal_Action
content_blocks.text: If the Tenant fails to vacate the premises as required, the Landlord reserves the right to file a lawsuit for unlawful detainer.
